def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()


def identity(path, name=None):
    body = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': name if name is not None else str(path), 'sha256': sha(body), 'size_bytes': len(body)}


def unique(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        assert key not in result, 'duplicate JSON key'
        result[key] = value
    return result


def document(body):
    return json.loads(body, object_pairs_hook=unique)

def retained(row):
    name = row['path']
    posix = PurePosixPath(name)
    assert str(posix) == name and not posix.is_absolute() and not {'.','..'} & set(posix.parts)
    path = PACKET/name
    assert path.resolve(strict=True) == path and path.is_file()
    data = path.read_bytes()
    observed = {'path': name, 'sha256': sha(data), 'size_bytes': len(data)}
    assert observed == row, 'retained descriptor mismatch: ' + name
    originals[name] = observed
    return data

def audit(event, args):
    if event in {'subprocess.Popen','os.system','os.exec','os.posix_spawn','ctypes.dlopen','exec','compile'} or event.startswith('socket.'):
        prohibited.append({'event':event,'reason':'execution/network/dynamic loading prohibited'})
        raise RuntimeError('prohibited review event: ' + event)
    if event in {'os.remove','os.rename','os.rmdir','os.mkdir','os.link','os.symlink'}:
        prohibited.append({'event':event,'reason':'filesystem mutation prohibited'})
        raise RuntimeError('prohibited filesystem mutation: ' + event)
    if event == 'open' and args:
        path, mode, flags = (list(args) + [None]*3)[:3]
        if ((type(mode) is str and any(ch in mode for ch in 'wax+'))
                or (type(flags) is int and flags & (os.O_WRONLY|os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_APPEND))):
            prohibited.append({'event':event,'reason':'new writable open prohibited'})
            raise RuntimeError('prohibited writable open')
        if isinstance(path, (str,bytes,os.PathLike)):
            p = Path(os.fsdecode(path)).absolute()
            if p.is_relative_to(PRODUCER) or any(p.is_relative_to(WORKSPACE/name) for name in ('work','tools','dependency-build','dependency-sources')):
                prohibited.append({'event':event,'path':str(p),'reason':'live producer-path read prohibited'})
                raise RuntimeError('prohibited producer-path read')

    def decode_half(bits, fmt):
        fraction_bits, exponent_bits, bias = (10,5,15) if fmt == 'fp16' else (7,8,127)
        sign = -1 if bits >> 15 else 1
        exponent = (bits >> fraction_bits) & ((1 << exponent_bits)-1)
        fraction = bits & ((1 << fraction_bits)-1)
        assert exponent != (1 << exponent_bits)-1
        significand = fraction if exponent == 0 else (1 << fraction_bits) + fraction
        power = (1-bias-fraction_bits) if exponent == 0 else exponent-bias-fraction_bits
        return sign * Fraction(significand) * (Fraction(2)**power)

    def unpack(words,fmt):
        values=[]
        for word in words:
            raw=int(word,16)
            values += [decode_half(raw & 65535,fmt),decode_half(raw >> 16,fmt)]
        assert all(value.denominator == 1 for value in values)
        return [int(x) for x in values]

    def exact_fp32_integer_bits(value):
        if value == 0:
            return '00000000'
        sign = int(value < 0) << 31
        magnitude=abs(value)
        assert magnitude < 1 << 24
        exponent=magnitude.bit_length()-1
        fraction=(magnitude-(1<<exponent)) << (23-exponent)
        return f'{sign|((127+exponent)<<23)|fraction:08x}'

    for case in expected_cases:
        a,b=unpack(case['a_words'],case['format']),unpack(case['b_words'],case['format'])
        assert len(a)==64 and len(b)==32
        values=[]; intermediates=[]
        for m in range(8):
            for n in range(4):
                accumulator=0
                for k in range(8):
                    product=a[m*8+k]*b[n*8+k]
                    accumulator+=product
                    intermediates.extend((product,accumulator))
                values.append(accumulator)
        bits=[exact_fp32_integer_bits(value) for value in values]
        assert max(map(abs,intermediates)) < (1<<24)
        assert bits == case['expected']
        record['integer_reconstructions'].append({'format':case['format'],'case_id':case['id'],
            'input_values_are_exact_integers':True,'a_layout':'row_major','b_layout':'column_major',
            'output_layout':'row_major','dimensions':[8,4,8],'expected_words':bits,
            'integer_results':values,'max_abs_product_or_partial_sum':max(map(abs,intermediates)),

    totals={'processes':0,'launches':0,'checked_words':0,'prime_operations':0,'prime_words':0,

        assert binding['build']['expected_loaded_libraries']==libraries
        command=next(x for x in report['commands'] if x['id']==process['command_id'])
        assert command['native_process'] is True and command['process_started'] is True
        assert command['outcome']=='pass' and command['exit_code']==0 and command['cleanup_complete'] is True
        assert command['argv'][command['argv'].index('--qualification-id')+1]==process['execution_binding_sha256']
        assert command['argv'][command['argv'].index('--policy')+1]==process['policy']
        assert command['log']==process['log']
        log=retained({'path':process['log'],'sha256':command['log_sha256'],'size_bytes':command['log_size_bytes']})
        text=log.decode('utf-8')
        arguments=dict(contract=contract,case=case,fmt=process['format'],policy=process['policy'],

        observed=records.verify_output(text,**arguments)
        assert observed==process['observation']==document(retained(process['retained_observation']))
        operations=[document(line[len('P06_WARM_OPERATION '):]) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('P06_WARM_OPERATION ')]
        assert len(operations)==33 and [x['operation_index'] for x in operations]==list(range(33))
        assert observed['warm']['operations']==operations
        assert observed['warm']['timed_operation_durations_ns']==observed['warm']['operation_durations_ns'][1:]
        assert len(observed['warm']['timed_operation_durations_ns'])==32
        for index, operation in enumerate(operations):

            assert operation['role']==('prime' if index==0 else 'sample')

            assert operation['dispatch']['waits']==1 and operation['dispatch']['timed_out_waits']==0

            totals['mismatches']+=operation['mismatches']
            prefix='prime' if index==0 else 'post_prime'
            totals[prefix+'_operations']+=1
            totals[prefix+'_words']+=len(operation['actual_bits'])
        totals['processes']+=1
        assert observed['warm']['summary']['operations']==33
        assert observed['warm']['summary']['checked']==1056
        assert observed['warm']['summary']['mismatches']==0
        assert observed['warm']['performance_acceptance'] is False and observed['warm']['phase_acceptance'] is False
        for witness in (observed['witness'],observed['lifetime']):
            assert all(witness[name] is False for name in manifest.FALSE_CLAIMS)
        row={'id':process['id'],'format':process['format'],'policy':process['policy'],'case_id':case['id'],
            'operations':len(operations),'launches':sum(x['dispatch']['launches'] for x in operations),
            'checked_words':sum(x['checked'] for x in operations),'raw_word_count':sum(len(x['actual_bits']) for x in operations),
            'prime_words':len(operations[0]['actual_bits']),'post_prime_operations':len(operations)-1,
            'mismatches':sum(x['mismatches'] for x in operations),'phase':process['phase'],'pair_index':process['pair_index'],
            'process_binding_sha256':process['execution_binding_sha256'],'build_binding_sha256':process['build_binding_sha256'],
            'log':originals[process['log']],'original_observation_matches_recomputation':True,
            'command_exit_code':command['exit_code'],'policy_final_counts':observed['warm']['summary']['counts']}
        record['processes'].append(row)
        if process['policy']=='per_operation':
            lines=text.splitlines(keepends=True)
            first=document(lines[0][len('P06_WARM_OPERATION '):])
            first['actual_bits'][0]=f'{int(first["actual_bits"][0],16)^1:08x}'
            assert first['mismatches']==0 and first['passed'] is True and first['role']=='prime'
            lines[0]='P06_WARM_OPERATION '+json.dumps(first,separators=(',',':'))+'\n'
            try:
                records.verify_output(''.join(lines),**arguments)
